# Code of Conduct

Oden follows the
[Rust Code of Conduct](https://www.rust-lang.org/policies/code-of-conduct) for
its issue tracker, pull requests, and discussions.

Be respectful, constructive, and focused on the technical topic. Maintainers may
moderate disruptive or abusive behavior.

For conduct concerns, contact the Oden repository maintainer privately if
possible. Do not use Deno's published conduct email address for Oden reports.
